question:
Refer to the exhibit. Which device alias database is shown by this output?
switch# show device-alias database
device-alias name SampleName pwwn 24:40:00:e7:09:5b:27:56
theory: A device alias database goes through a pending state while changes are staged and an effective (active) state once 'device-alias commit' has distributed and applied them; the 'show device-alias database' output listing a name-to-pWWN mapping with no 'pending' indicator, as shown here, is displaying the effective database currently enforced fabric-wide, not the pending or inactive one. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 8 - Device Alias)
